title: Meals and Reclining at Table
summary: Formal meals could involve reclining, ordered seating, hospitality customs, honor, and shared fellowship.
background: Many Gospel scenes unfold around meals, where Jesus teaches grace, exposes pride, receives sinners, and redefines fellowship around the kingdom of God.
teachingHelp: When teaching meal scenes, look for honor, shame, welcome, exclusion, and who is being invited to fellowship.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
